**Coaching note:**

Your rooks on the c-file can deliver checkmate by checking the king up the board. Play **Rc1+** to force the king forward. After Ke2, play R8c2+ (both rooks check the escape squares). When the king moves to e3, Re1 is checkmate—the rooks control all escape squares and the bishop blocks f6. Always look for ways to use your rooks together on an open file against an exposed king.
